headline: Retired Couple's 15-Year Mission: Fostering 59 Dogs to Freedom
meta_description: Nicole and Gary Wordsworth have fostered 59 dogs from Battersea Dogs Home in their retirement, giving stressed animals a quiet home before adoption.
summary_short: A British couple in their 60s has fostered 59 dogs over 15 years, helping rescue animals decompress before finding permanent homes.
body:
For 15 years, Nicole and Gary Wordsworth have opened their home to dogs in crisis, fostering 59 animals from the Battersea Dogs Home in Buckinghamshire. Now retired, the couple takes in pups for stays ranging from a couple of nights to 18 months, offering them the quiet, stress-free environment they need to heal and reveal their true personalities. Their work isn't just about companionship—it's practical rescue. The information they gather about each dog's preferences, routines, and temperament directly helps Battersea's adoption staff find the perfect permanent match. "We love to help get them out of the kennels when they are too stressed and need a quiet spot to perch," Nicole explains. "It's always a joy to hear how they are doing after they leave us."

The Wordsworths stumbled into fostering by accident. After regularly minding friends' dogs, they spotted an advertisement for sponsoring dogs at Battersea in late 2011 and decided to try it—their first foster was a Staffie named Marcel. What began as curiosity became a calling. Among their most memorable guests was a huge American bulldog who learned to sit, lie down, and offer his paw—and was eventually reunited with his original owner who found him through Battersea's adoption listing. More recently, a husky named Stormy spent four months with them, delighting the couple with her "happy food dance" whenever dinner was being prepared.

"It is impossible to pick a favorite," Gary says. "But some stick in your mind more than others." The couple emphasizes that fostering isn't intimidating: Battersea provides training, covers all costs, and typically starts newcomers with calmer dogs. For those considering retirement with purpose, they offer a simple truth: "You are doing a good thing and you get to have a furry friend by your side. It's a win-win."
quick_facts: British couple fostered 59 dogs from Battersea Dogs Home over 15 years
Stays range from two nights to 18 months depending on each dog
Foster information helps staff find perfect permanent homes for each animal
Battersea covers all costs and provides training for new foster volunteers
